subject: Gerudo's Fortress
text: If caught without the hookshot or longshot, Link is thrown out in front of the carpenter's tent instead of into the cell.

evidence.quote:
!!!!!If you get caught and you don't have the hookshot/longshot you'll be  
!!!!!thrown out in front of the carpenter’s tent instead of in the normal 
!!!!!cell

subject: Gerudo Guard
text: Deku Nuts can stun the dual-sword Gerudo in the middle of any attack.

evidence.quote: Deku nuts can stun her in the middle of any of her attacks including her special attack that catches you if you get hit by it.

subject: First Carpenter Cell
text: Defeating the first dual-sword Gerudo leaves a small key used to free the first carpenter.

evidence.quote:
With the woman defeated she runs away and leaves a small key, now go let  
the carpenter out (NOTE: the carpenters will not just leave once you've  
opened the cell, you have to talk to them first unlike the Gorons in the  
Fire Temple).

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: A fairy fountain hidden near crates across from the first carpenter's exit requires the Song of Storms to access.

evidence.quote:
also a fairy fountain hidden near the crates across from you  
that requires the song of storms to access

subject: Second Carpenter Cell
text: Defeating the second dual-sword Gerudo yields another small key to free the second carpenter.

evidence.quote:
When you go talk to him you'll  
be attacked by another Gerudo with two swords use the same tactics as  
before and when she's defeated, you'll get another small key.

subject: Third Carpenter Cell
text: Defeating the guard guarding the third carpenter yields a small key to release him.

evidence.quote:
Go strait first and you'll find your self inside the fortress 
where there's the third carpenter.  Talk to him and fight the guard.  When 
you get the key release the girly carpenter

subject: Fourth Carpenter Cell
text: Defeating the dual-sword Gerudo guarding the fourth carpenter drops the key to his cell.

evidence.quote:
After talking to him you'll be attacked and you get to beat the Gerudo 
with two swords again.  She'll drop the key to his door and thus allow you to 
free the carpenter.

subject: Gerudo's Membership Card
text: Freeing all four carpenters causes the second-in-command Gerudo to drop down and grant the Gerudo's Membership Card.

evidence.quote:
once freed the second in command Gerudo will drop down 
(wearing the same color outfit as your current tunic, if you change tunics 
her outfit will change to match).  She'll give you the membership card 
which will allow you to roam freely through the fortress.

subject: Cooking Pot Room
text: Reaching the elevated platform in the cooking pot room requires the hover boots or hookshot/longshot.

evidence.quote:
You can't jump to that small platform sticking out of the wall because  
of how far away it is.  The only way to get to it is using the hover boots  
or the hookshot/longshot.

subject: Pierre the Scarecrow
text: Playing your custom scarecrow song to the lone scarecrow on the bank near the Lake Hylia fishing pond allows you to summon him where Navi reacts.

evidence.quote:
run up to where the lone scarecrow is on the bank near the fishing  
pond and play that song you made up.  With your new song you can call the  
scarecrow to certain places where Navi reacts.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching the middle fish in the Lake Hylia fishing pond awards the Gold Scale.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Lakeside  
Laboratory and ride on the plant next to it to the fishing pond.  Go in and  
catch that middle fish again to get the Gold Scale.

subject: Lakeside Laboratory
text: Diving to the bottom of the water pool inside the Lakeside Laboratory awards Piece of Heart 22 from the man.

evidence.quote:
Go in, jump in the water, and dive till  
you touch the bottom, now talk to the man, and collect [PoH22].

subject: Hyrule Field Grotto
text: Bombing the tree on the hill between Gerudo Valley and Lon Lon Ranch opens a grotto where Piece of Heart 23 sits at the bottom of a pool.

evidence.quote:
As  
you go up the hill go to the first tree to your left and set a bomb next  
to it.  A hole will open up and you'll see a tektite on top of the water.   
Kill it and dive into the water and get [PoH23] from the bottom of the  
pool.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: Talking to the cucco lady in Kakariko Village during daytime gives you a Pocket Cucco Egg.

evidence.quote:
Head to  
Kakoriko (make sure it's day time) and talk to the cucco lady, she'll give  
you a pocket cucco egg.

subject: Talon
text: Waking Talon with the hatched cucco and returning to the cucco lady rewards you with the blue cucco Cojiro.

evidence.quote:
Now go into the house at the bottom of the large  
set of stairs and you'll see Talon a sleep.  Use the cucco to wake him up  
and head back to the cucco lady.  Use the cucco near her and she'll give  
you a blue cucco Cojiro.

subject: Windmill
text: Entering the windmill in Kakariko Village allows Link to learn the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote:
Before you leave run into the windmill and  
learn the Song of Storms.

subject: Grog
text: Showing Cojiro to the young punk kid in the Lost Woods yields a forest mushroom that spoils in 3 minutes.

evidence.quote:
from the entrance go left and you'll see a 
young punk kid where the Stalchild used to be.  Show him Cojiro and he'll 
give you a forest mushroom which will spoil in three minutes.

subject: Old Hag's Potion Shop
text: Giving the mushroom to the old hag awards an odd potion and unlocks blue potions for 100 rupees.

evidence.quote:
now run across to the old hag's potion shop.  She'll take the 
mushroom on the second try (never worked for me on the first try) and give 
you an odd potion (from this point on you can buy blue potions from her for
100 rupees).

subject: Fado
text: Trading the odd potion to the Kokiri girl in the Lost Woods yields the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote:
Now take the odd potion back to the Lost Woods where you'll see a Kokiri  
there in place of the guy from before.  She'll trade the odd potion for the 
poacher's saw.

subject: Master Craftsman
text: Talking to the carpenter outside the tent in Gerudo Valley yields the Broken Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the carpenter outside the tent and he'll  
give you a broken biggoron's sword.

subject: Link the Goron
text: Bombing the rolling Goron in Goron City unlocks Darunia's room and gives Link the Goron Tunic.

evidence.quote:
In Goron City you'll notice  
there's only one Goron there and he's rolling around.  Bomb him and he'll  
unlock Durana's room and give you the Goron's Tunic.

subject: Biggoron
text: Showing the broken sword to Biggoron at the peak of Death Mountain yields a prescription for eye drops.

evidence.quote:
To your left 
you'll see Biggoron, show him the broken sword and he'll give you a 
prescription for his eye drops.

subject: Goron City Entrance Grotto
text: Playing the Song of Storms in the circle of rocks outside Goron City opens a grotto with a bottleable fish and a chest with 200 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Stand in the middle of  
the circle of rocks and play the song of storms and a hole will open.   
inside you'll find a fish (bottle it) and a treasure chest with 200 rupees  
in it.

subject: Beggar
text: The beggar next to the Kakariko item shop buys a bottled fish for 100 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Before going into the potion shop go to the  
beggar next to the item shop and sell him your fish for 100 rupees.

subject: King Zora
text: Using Blue Fire to unfreeze King Zora yields the Zora Tunic, and showing him the prescription grants an Eyeball Frog with a 3 minute timer to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Go up to King Zora and stand next to him and use  
the blue fire.  Once he's unfrozen he'll give you the Zora's tunic and when 
you show him the prescription he'll give you an eyeball frog (you have  
three minutes to get to Lake Hylia).

subject: Eyeball Frog Delivery Route
text: From Zora's River enter the Lost Woods portal and go straight, left, right, straight, and left to reach the bean plant exit to Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote:
Exit to Zora's river and go to the left through the portal  
to the lost woods.  Once there go strait then left then right then strait  
and left and you'll be at your plant from before that can get you out of  
the forest quickly (jump off onto the bridge).

subject: Lakeside Laboratory Scientist
text: Showing the Eyeball Frog to the scientist at Lake Hylia rewards Link with eye drops with a 4 minute timer to reach Death Mountain.

evidence.quote:
After showing the frog to the guy there, he'll give you the eye drops...now 
you have four minutes to get to the top of Death Mountain.

subject: Biggoron
text: Delivering the eye drops to Biggoron gives the Claim Check, which he exchanges for the Biggoron's Sword after 3 days.

evidence.quote:
Give the eye drops to Biggoron and he'll give you the  
claim check for the broken sword.  In three days he'll exchange the  
claim check for the Biggoron's sword.

subject: Graveyard Crate
text: Riding the magic bean plant up in the graveyard allows Link to break a crate containing Piece of Heart 24.

evidence.quote:
Ride your magic bean pant up  
and break the crate where you'll see [PoH24].

subject: Dampé's Crypt
text: Pulling the corner grave near the bean plant leads into Dampé's race, which awards the Hookshot at the finish line.

evidence.quote:
Now pull the corner grave  
closest to your bean plant out and drop into the hole.  You see the ghost 
of Dampe in front of you wanting to race you...When you get to the end with him 
he'll give you the hookshot.

subject: Dampé's Race
text: Completing Dampé's race a second time in 1 minute or less rewards Link with Piece of Heart 25.

evidence.quote:
Now go back into 
the grave and beat him again but this time in one minute or less....When you get 
into the room where he gave you the hookshot, if you did it in one minute 
or less you'll be rewarded with [PoH25].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS045
text: At night, hookshotting from the House of Skulltula roof to the cucco lady's roof reveals Gold Skulltula GS045 on the town wall.

evidence.quote:
make it night time 
and go to the cucco lady's house.  Stand on the crate next to her door and 
shoot the roof of the House of Skullita.  From that roof turn back around 
and hookshot the cucco lady's roof, against the wall of the town you'll see 
[GS045].

subject: Gold Skulltula GS046
text: At night, Gold Skulltula GS046 is found on the back side of the platform suspended by ropes in Goron City.

evidence.quote:
Head to Goron city (still night time) and walk out onto the 
platform being held up by ropes.  On the back side of the platform, you'll 
see [GS046].

subject: Death Mountain Crater Entrance
text: Entering Death Mountain behind the statue in Darunia's room leads to the entrance of the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote:
Now go into Death mountain (via the entrance behind the 
statue in Durana's room) and enter the Fire Temple.

subject: Fire Temple Map Room
text: In the room following the boulder maze, you can bypass the silver eye switch by climbing over the side of the cage and dropping directly onto the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Pass the door and walk to the cage and you'll  
see that you can climb over the side of the cage where you'll drop onto the 
map.

subject: Fire Temple Hidden Room Skulltula
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song on the second level of the boulder maze room reveals a scarecrow that can be hookshotted to reach a hidden room with a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The most frequently missed Skullita is near there as well.  walk out  
onto the second level of that room with the maze of rolling boulders and  
play the scarecrow's song.  Hookshot the scarecrow then turn around and  
hookshot the target leading up to a hidden room.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS044
text: If it's dark out, you'll hear a [GS044] Gold Skullita on the wall, and the easiest way to kill it is by timing throwing bombs.

evidence.quote:
You'll also hear a [GS044] if it's dark out who's up against the wall
 to your back right....Climb the wall and follow the top to where you'll 
see the Gold Skullita on the wall.  The easiest way to kill it is by timing 
throwing bombs.
